subject.size_in_frame: the open page fills the frame edge to edge; the gutter falls just left of centre at x 0.44

headroom: none — a flat insert. The page bleeds all four edges so there is no margin of grass or sky anywhere.
horizon_eyeline: The lines of type are the horizon: a stack of dead-level grey rules across the whole frame. Alice's eye-line is the lens, about 0.3 m above the page and a few degrees off square so the paper takes no glare.

layers.fg: the sister's thumb at the lower right margin, the only warm colour and the only curved shape in frame
layers.mg: the page plane itself, grey type margin to margin, sharp corner to corner
layers.bg: none — the page occludes everything; the shot is a single plane by design

gaze.note: POV insert from Alice's eye-line at the sitting place; no one looks in this frame.

balance: Flat, even, airless: uniform grey texture across all nine cells, broken only by the thumb at bottom right. The evenness is the answer to her question.
leading_lines: Parallel lines of type running left to right, and the gutter as a single soft vertical — a grid with nothing in it. No line leads anywhere.
eye_first: The middle of the page, which offers nothing, then out to the thumb at the lower right for the only thing to look at.
constraint_binding: Edge-to-edge grey type, no illustration and no drop cap: no picture, initial or ornament may sit anywhere in frame, including outside title-safe. Nothing here needs to be legible, so no word is placed on a safe-area line.
